page_title: LIL 4-0 CLE | Lille v Clermont 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+3' A sweet pass finds Benjamin Andre (Lille) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Mory Diaw is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' One of the Clermont players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
86' Lille are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
83' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Shamar Nicholson will be replaced by Grejohn Kyei (Clermont).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrej Ilic (Lille) is coming onto the pitch as Jonathan David cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 12:3.
78' Some neat passing and movement from Lille as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
74' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) replaces Ismaily.
73' The Lille players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' The resulting corner from Remy Cabella (Lille) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
69' Clermont keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
65' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Adam Ounas is replaced by Remy Cabella (Lille).
65' Substitution. Angel Gomes walks off the pitch and Yusuf Yazici (Lille) comes on as a substitute.
64' Substitution. Edon Zhegrova did his best and is replaced by Tiago Morais (Lille).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Muhammed Cham (Clermont) replaces Bilal Boutobba.
63' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) replacing Johan Gastien.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) is replacing Jim Allevinah.
60' Jonathan David (Lille) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
60' The ball is laid off to Angel Gomes (Lille) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Mory Diaw to make a decent save.
58' A cross from a corner kick by Lille is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
56' A player from Clermont brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
54' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Jonathan David (Lille) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Mory Diaw makes a comfortable save.
51' Jonathan David (Lille) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
47' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

47' Tiago Santos (Lille) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the top left corner, but Mory Diaw keeps it out with an amazing save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lille.
47' A player from Clermont takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Pascal Gastien is forced to make a change. Maximiliano Caufriez is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Florent Ogier (Clermont).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The end of the first half.

45+7' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
45+6' Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jonathan David (Lille).
45+5' Clermont are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

45+2' The ball rebounds out to Tiago Santos (Lille) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
45+1' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Clermont comes to nothing.
44' Lille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

40' 4 - 0 Goal! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) receives a precise pass and produces a wonderful long-range shot! His incredible effort beats the surprised goalkeeper and goes into the left side of the goal via the post.
38' 3 - 0 GOAL! Jonathan David (Lille) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 4:0.
37' A corner kick by Lille is thwarted by the well prepared Mory Diaw (Clermont).
37' Lille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
36' Clermont keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

33' Ooh that was close! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
31' Lille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lille.
27' One of the Clermont players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
25' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) picks up a yellow card.
25' Referee Bastien Dechepy points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Benjamin Andre (Lille) goes wild in celebration.
24' Benjamin Andre (Lille) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Bastien Dechepy immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
24' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Edon Zhegrova sends a long raking pass onto the head of Benjamin Andre (Lille), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
23' Lille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
22' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' One of the Lille players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
18' Lille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
15' A player from Clermont commits a rough challenge. Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
13' A great pass puts Adam Ounas (Lille) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
13' Clermont are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' 1 - 0 Jonathan David (Lille) receives a super pass into the box and shoots into the top right corner. What a nice goal!
7' Lille fail to score from a corner as Mory Diaw (Clermont) leaps to collect the ball.
6' A player from Clermont pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.

3' Jonathan David (Lille) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.

2' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
2' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
